primary.title: Sovereign Gold Bond: ₹1 lakh grows to ₹3.09 lakh as RBI fixes SGB redemption price at ₹14,159; check returns
primary.summary: Sovereign Gold Bond investors have earned nearly 209% returns as RBI fixes the SGB 2020-21 Series I redemption price at ₹14,159 per gram. A ₹1 lakh investment is now worth around ₹3.09 lakh. Check returns, interest earnings and tax rules
